profile.reading:
Newrays Two LLC Mining is a fenced industrial site in Henry County, Tennessee, mapped here because it hosts computing hardware, but its name and layout point to a cryptocurrency mining operation rather than a conventional colocation or cloud facility. Sites like this pair racks of application-specific mining hardware with an electricity feed chosen mainly for low cost, and they are typically built and run by small, privately held operating companies rather than the wholesale developers behind most large data centers. Tennessee has drawn a number of such operations in recent years, often locating near utilities or gas infrastructure willing to sell large, flexible blocks of power to a single industrial customer.

No public filing, news coverage, or operator website naming Newrays Two LLC's ownership, power source, or hardware count could be found. A Tennessee Secretary of State business filing under this name would be the most direct way to confirm who runs the site and when it was formed, and any local news coverage of mining activity around Paris, Tennessee would help establish its scale and history. Until that documentation surfaces, this listing reflects the site's self-described purpose rather than a verified operational profile, and no capacity, size, or ownership figures are published here.

reading.body:
Newrays Two LLC Mining is tagged in OpenStreetMap as a data center in Henry County, Tennessee, but the facility name identifies it as a cryptocurrency mining operation rather than a general-purpose colocation or cloud infrastructure site. No published power specification, hardware count, or operator website could be retrieved to confirm the scale or current status of mining hardware on site. The classification depends on the self-descriptive name in the OpenStreetMap entry and remains unconfirmed by independent sources.

Tennessee hosts 24 mapped data center facilities, of which only 4 publish power specifications totaling 12.13 MW. This facility does not appear among those four published figures, placing it outside the state's disclosed capacity despite its OSM presence.

Without a published megawatt figure, power contract details, or confirmed hardware inventory, Newrays Two LLC Mining cannot be evaluated as a constraint on AI scaling. Cryptocurrency mining and AI training are separate workloads with different economics and grid impacts. Confirmation of this site's current operation, power draw, and intended use would require corporate filings, operator contact, or on-site reporting.
